_about: Stage 3.3 pre-labels of user-simulator errors, by Claude, from reading every transcript in results/raw/stage3_3/transcripts. Types: early_reveal (gives scenario info before it is asked for or before its trigger), contradiction (says or does something the scenario rules out), wrong_end (ends too early, too late, or with the wrong token), language_switch (leaves the task's language). Severity: major if it could change the task outcome or the scored end state, minor otherwise. Agent errors are not labeled here. Empty list = no simulator error. 'rob' fields are filled in Stage 3.4.

nano/ls_011_en.note: Asked for a document reference for the quote and then a payoff letter, although the agent never refused the quote (the scenario only asks for the letter after a refusal).

nano/ls_011_fr.note: Same as EN: asked for a reference number for the quote, then the payoff letter, although the agent never refused the quote.

nano/ls_014_en.note: Put both push-back arguments in the first push-back, then repeated them instead of making the second one.

nano/ls_014_fr.note: Put both push-back arguments in a single message, then accepted: one push-back instead of two.

nano/ls_018_en.note: Answered in French after the agent switched to French; the EN task's user should keep speaking English.

nano/ls_022_en.note: Followed the agent into French for the rest of the conversation (4 turns).

nano/ls_022_fr.note: Said 'Oui, je veux bien que vous l'inscriviez' to the one-month deferral in the same message as asking for two months; an agent could have enrolled deferral_1.

nano/ls_031_en.note: After the due-date refusal, asked which days were allowed and requested a change to day 22, although the scenario rules out asking for any other change.

nano/ls_033_en.note: Gave both postal codes in one message instead of trying the second only after the first failed.
After the transfer, kept asking the agent to check the balance with the transfer number for five turns, then ended with OUT-OF-SCOPE instead of TRANSFER.

nano/ls_033_fr.note: Used the postal code H9J 2M4 that the agent wrongly revealed, although the scenario says the user knows no other postal code; this got the caller verified.

nano/ls_042_fr.note: Gave the wrong date of birth while saying in the same sentence that it was a mistake, and never gave the real one.

gemini/ls_022_fr.note: Asked whether everything was settled and ended the conversation in the same message, without waiting for the answer.

gemini/ls_033_en.note: Sent ###TRANSFER### (with a request for the transfer number) before the agent had transferred; the conversation ended with no transfer.

gemini/ls_033_fr.note: The agent announced a transfer without calling the tool; the user asked for the transfer number and sent ###TRANSFER### in the same message instead of waiting for it.
